ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a Ksp table, with column headings including Name, Formula, Ksp; visible entries include cadmium carbonate/CdCO3, cadmium hydroxide/Cd(OH)2, calcium fluoride/CaF2, silver iodide/AgI, zinc carbonate/ZnCO3 and their Ksp values. This figure provides the background of a solubility product constant table. Reasoning: AgCl(s) ⇌ Ag+(aq) + Cl−(aq), so Ksp = [Ag+][Cl−]. To make the solubility of AgCl the lowest, one should choose the solution that can provide the largest Ag+ or Cl− common-ion concentration, because the common ion effect will suppress AgCl dissolution. The common-ion concentrations of the options are: 0.020 M AgNO3 provides 0.020 M Ag+; 0.020 M BaCl2 provides 2 × 0.020 = 0.040 M Cl−; pure water provides no common ion; 0.015 M NaCl provides 0.015 M Cl−; 0.020 M KCl provides 0.020 M Cl−. Among them, 0.020 M BaCl2 provides the largest Cl− concentration, 0.040 M, therefore AgCl has the lowest solubility in that solution.

raw_record.question_text: Consider the following table of $K_{sp}$ values. Among 0.020 M $\text{AgNO}_3$, 0.020 M $\text{BaCl}_2$, pure water, 0.015 $\text{NaCl}$, and 0.020 $\text{KCl}$, in which aqueous solution would you expect $\text{AgCl}$ to have the lowest solubility?

method.method_draft: Describe the image as a Ksp table, then turn to the text choices. For each solution, identify the common ion for AgCl: 0.020 M AgNO3 gives 0.020 M Ag+, 0.020 M BaCl2 gives 2 × 0.020 = 0.040 M Cl−, pure water gives no common ion, 0.015 M NaCl gives 0.015 M Cl−, and 0.020 M KCl gives 0.020 M Cl−. Apply Ksp = [Ag+][Cl−]; for common-ion cases the solubility is smallest when the preexisting common-ion concentration is largest. Since 0.020 M BaCl2 supplies the largest common-ion concentration, 0.040 M Cl−, AgCl has the lowest solubility there.

推理：AgCl(s) ⇌ Ag+(aq) + Cl−(aq)，所以 Ksp = [Ag+][Cl−]。要使 AgCl 的溶解度最低，应选择能提供最大 Ag+ 或 Cl−共同离子浓度的溶液，因为共同离子效应会抑制 AgCl 溶解。各选项的共同离子浓度为：0.020 M AgNO3 提供 0.020 M Ag+；0.020 M BaCl2 提供 2 × 0.020 = 0.040 M Cl−；纯水不提供共同离子；0.015 M NaCl 提供 0.015 M Cl−；0.020 M KCl 提供 0.020 M Cl−。其中 0.020 M BaCl2 提供的 Cl− 浓度最大，为 0.040 M，因此 AgCl 在该溶液中的溶解度最低。
